items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: The fellow used to play banjo or guitar with Fletcher Henderson. He made that. I had him on the side.

ctx.x: So, I was, I had 2 set of books. All of them went up to 1,000 tunes in each set. That's how many tunes I had. And, I had a lot of original things. When I record, when they'd bring an original tune, if I liked it and I saw possibility, I'd go down and I'd record it for them. You know, I did a lot of original recording. So, if they, they made big, they'd stay there on top.
So primarily, your arranging was done by Sammy Lowe, Avery Parrish,
Yeah. And William Leroy Kirkland, guitar. He was in there.
